title: E0075: Session security
plain_english: Calling `session_start()` without secure cookie settings can leave session IDs vulnerable to interception and theft.
why_matters: Insecure session configuration can allow attackers to: - Steal session cookies over unencrypted HTTP - Access session data via JavaScript in an XSS attack - Fixate session IDs before authentication - Hijack authenticated user sessions
what_it_checks: `session_start()` without prior `session_set_cookie_params()` setting `secure => true` and `httponly => true`
